Use **Saturday, December 5, 2026, 02:00–05:00 UTC** as the Postgres 17 maintenance window in both the customer notice and the support macro. The approved schedule in Linear ticket KES-398 supersedes the November 21 window still shown in the Notion runbook and the original Slack announcement [2][1][3].

The customer notice is scheduled for **Saturday, November 28**, on the status page and as an in-app banner [2].
